schema_controls.entropy: Existing measurement::fixture(N,"opaque",seed), with N=floor(target_length/256)*115+target_length%256. Consume115bytes/record: first4little-endian bytes asu32 added to1,000,000,000 (u64, always10decimal digits); remaining111bytes encoded as222lowercase hex characters.
schema_controls.fit: floor(target_length/256) records of {"value":<10digits>,"message":"<222hex>"} plus LF, exactly256bytes each.
schema_controls.drift: Same record shape and length with independent drift_seed; first record uses message, all subsequent records replace message with equal-length untrained key drifted. One useful fitted record remains, so schema candidate is not policy-skipped.
schema_controls.tail: Consume remaining target_length%256 entropy bytes after records; map each to lowercase ASCII a+(byte%26), without LF. Exact tier length retained; tail is explicit literal.
